## Claim

The defect this addresses, cited by ID, with the file:line evidence that it is real.

## Change

What moved. One line each.

## Evidence

The exact commands run, each in its own fenced block so it stays runnable, with its
result on the line after the block. Include the negative control: the new test against
the pre-fix commit, and how it failed there. A test that cannot fail proves nothing.

## Possible caveats

What this does not cover, what was investigated and refuted, pre-existing failures
observed and left unfixed, and the rollback. At most four items. Expected to be
non-empty.
